comparator-comparing-chaining.title: Chaining comparators
comparator-comparing-chaining.summary: Comparator.comparing and thenComparing build readable multi-key ordering rules.
comparator-comparing-chaining.why: Composed comparators keep ordering logic explicit without a long hand-written compare method.
comparator-comparing-chaining.tips: Use comparingInt, comparingLong, or comparingDouble for primitive numeric keys to avoid boxing.

instant-duration-elapsed-time.title: Measure elapsed time with Instant and Duration
instant-duration-elapsed-time.summary: Duration.between computes a time-based amount between two temporal points.
instant-duration-elapsed-time.why: The java.time API gives explicit types for instants and durations instead of mixing timestamps with arithmetic.
instant-duration-elapsed-time.tips: For precise benchmarking prefer System.nanoTime; Instant and Duration are appropriate for application-level time intervals.

collections-frequency.title: Count equal elements with Collections.frequency
collections-frequency.summary: Collections.frequency returns how many elements are equal to a target value.
collections-frequency.why: It is concise for one-off counts where building a frequency map would be unnecessary.
collections-frequency.tips: For many repeated queries, build a Map of counts instead of scanning the collection each time.

files-walk-stream.title: Walk a file tree as a Stream
files-walk-stream.summary: Files.walk returns a lazy Stream of paths rooted at a directory.
files-walk-stream.why: It composes naturally with filters and other Stream operations for filesystem searches.
files-walk-stream.tips: Close the returned Stream with try-with-resources because traversal may hold open directory resources.

date-time-exception.title: Invalid date or time value
date-time-exception.summary: java.time operations throw DateTimeException when a requested temporal value is invalid.
date-time-exception.why: Dates such as February 30 cannot be represented by LocalDate.
date-time-exception.tips: Validate external date parts or parse them with an appropriate formatter and error handling.

unchecked-io-exception.title: UncheckedIOException
unchecked-io-exception.short: Wrap an IOException for unchecked propagation
unchecked-io-exception.summary: UncheckedIOException wraps an IOException when an API cannot conveniently declare a checked exception.
unchecked-io-exception.why: It is commonly useful across functional interfaces whose method signatures do not declare IOException.
unchecked-io-exception.tips: Preserve the original IOException as the cause and handle it at a meaningful boundary.

multi-catch-related-types-error.title: Related alternatives in multi-catch
multi-catch-related-types-error.short: Multi-catch alternatives must not be subclasses of each other
multi-catch-related-types-error.summary: A multi-catch cannot list exception types when one alternative is a subclass of another.
multi-catch-related-types-error.why: The broader catch type already includes its subclass, so the alternatives would overlap.
multi-catch-related-types-error.tips: Catch the common superclass once, or use separate catch blocks when behavior must differ.

lambda-incompatible-return-type.title: Lambda returns the wrong type
lambda-incompatible-return-type.short: Match the functional interface result type
lambda-incompatible-return-type.summary: A lambda expression must produce a value compatible with the return type of its target functional interface.
lambda-incompatible-return-type.why: Target typing checks the lambda body against the single abstract method signature.
lambda-incompatible-return-type.tips: Read the target interface method signature first when a lambda type error is unclear.

serial-version-uid-warning.title: Missing serialVersionUID warning
serial-version-uid-warning.short: Declare a stable serialization version identifier
serial-version-uid-warning.summary: Compilers and lint tools can warn when a Serializable class does not declare serialVersionUID.
serial-version-uid-warning.why: An explicit identifier makes serialization compatibility intent visible instead of relying on a generated value.
serial-version-uid-warning.tips: Do not treat Java serialization as a general interchange format; use it only where its compatibility model fits.

parallel-stream-shared-mutation.title: Shared mutation in a parallel stream
parallel-stream-shared-mutation.summary: Parallel stream callbacks may execute concurrently, so mutating a shared collection can race.
parallel-stream-shared-mutation.why: The result can become incorrect or fail when several worker threads modify the same state.
parallel-stream-shared-mutation.tips: Prefer stream reductions and collectors that combine results safely instead of side effects.
